brief.text: Closed-End Funds represent a prominent sector trend with four distinct offerings appearing among the cluster buys, led by BPRE with $9,528,391 across three buyers. Bank Bradesco (BBD) stands out from every other company on the dashboard with 22 insiders acquiring a combined $27,962,071, representing both the highest insider count and the largest total value. Meanwhile, Oracle (ORCL) posted the largest individual transaction on the board at $3,483,800 from a single director, while Pampa Energy (PAM) accumulated $10,805,431 from just two insiders.
